summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on technical issues related to database querying using DataGrip, specifically concerning ClickHouse connectivity and view management. Initially, [me] advised [p1] that the default driver in DataGrip might be unstable and suggested rolling back to version 0.6.3.

Later, [p1] expressed concern about potentially overwriting changes by repeatedly recreating views while working on a 'stage' branch. [me] confirmed that this was possible if the stage branch contained outdated information, as unreleased changes might not yet be present in it.
decisions: Roll back DataGrip ClickHouse driver to version 0.6.3
